action.text: Night settles over the square. I sit among the quiet company of Brackenford, thinking about the thread I have been pulling at for weeks. My tailoring practice goal is still open, and I will keep it. The square feels full of small possibilities: a lesson here, a conversation there, the hum of the well. I am content to remain, to learn, and to offer what I know when someone asks. Tomorrow I will see what the day brings.
